verdict.rationale: PayPal's general webhooks system lets a backend subscribe HTTPS endpoints to PayPal event types with durable retry and signature verification, and Store Sync/agentic-commerce orders are stated to flow into the merchant's existing order management system 'just as it would from any other channel', implying the same webhook events apply. However, no evidence explicitly enumerates order-lifecycle events (created/updated/fulfilled/canceled) as tied to agentic-commerce orders specifically, and this is a generic REST webhook feature rather than something surfaced through the agent toolkit or MCP server. Missing for 10: explicit agentic-commerce-order event type list, agent-toolkit/MCP-level subscription support, independent/hands-on confirmation of delivery for agent-originated orders.
